📺 Shameless (US) (2011–2021)

Shameless follows the chaotic and unpredictable lives of the Gallagher family, a struggling working-class household living on the South Side of Chicago. With their irresponsible, alcoholic father Frank Gallagher constantly causing trouble and their mother largely absent, the six Gallagher children are forced to grow up quickly and depend on one another to survive. At the center of the family is Fiona Gallagher, the eldest daughter, who sacrifices much of her own happiness to raise her younger siblings while balancing relationships, financial struggles, and the challenges of adulthood. Alongside her are the intelligent but rebellious Lip, determined Ian, fearless Debbie, troublemaking Carl, and youngest brother Liam. As the family navigates poverty, complicated romances, unexpected opportunities, and outrageous situations, they prove that loyalty and love can survive even the messiest circumstances. Starring William H. Macy, Emmy Rossum, Jeremy Allen White, Cameron Monaghan, Emma Kenney, and Ethan Cutkosky, the series combines outrageous comedy, emotional drama, unforgettable characters, and powerful storytelling about family, survival, sacrifice, and resilience.

🎭 Genre: Comedy • Drama • Family • Dark Comedy

⭐ IMDb: 8.5/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 45–60 minutes per episode • TV-MA

🎥 Developer: John Wells

📺 Seasons: 11 • 134 Episodes

📚 Based On: The British television series Shameless (2004–2013), created by Paul Abbott.

🏆 Awards: Winner of multiple Primetime Emmy Awards, including Outstanding Guest Actress in a Comedy Series for Joan Cusack.

📺 Where to Watch: Netflix • Paramount+ with Showtime (United States; availability may vary)
